description: Admin Dashboard - Full platform oversight with user management, content moderation, billing oversight, analytics, and real-time monitoring

userStories.title: Create user_profiles table with admin role system
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a user_profiles table with a role column so that admin access can be determined and enforced at the database level.
acceptanceCriteria: Create user_profiles table with columns: id (UUID, references auth.users), role (text, check constraint 'user' or 'admin', default 'user'), disabled_at (timestamptz, nullable), created_at (timestamptz), updated_at (timestamptz)
Create updated_at trigger on user_profiles (same pattern as other tables)
Create RLS policies: users can SELECT their own profile row; service role bypasses all RLS
Create a database trigger function that auto-inserts a user_profiles row with role='user' when a new auth.users entry is created
Insert admin profile row for jason.solomons@eyedz9.com by looking up their auth.users id
Migration runs successfully via supabase migration apply
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create audit_logs and system_settings tables
userStories.description: As a developer, I need audit_logs and system_settings tables so that admin actions are tracked and platform settings are configurable.
acceptanceCriteria: Create audit_logs table: id (UUID), actor_id (UUID, references auth.users), target_type (text), target_id (text), action (text), details (JSONB), ip_address (text, nullable), created_at (timestamptz default now())
Create index on audit_logs(created_at DESC) for efficient querying
Create index on audit_logs(actor_id) for filtering by admin
Create index on audit_logs(target_type, target_id) for filtering by target
Create system_settings table: key (text primary key), value (JSONB), updated_at (timestamptz), updated_by (UUID, references auth.users, nullable)
Insert default system_settings rows: default_trial_days=14, maintenance_mode=false, registration_enabled=true
RLS on audit_logs: only service role can INSERT/SELECT (no user access)
RLS on system_settings: users can SELECT; only service role can INSERT/UPDATE
Migration runs successfully
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add moderation columns to content tables

acceptanceCriteria: Add moderation_status column (text, default 'active', check constraint: 'active','flagged','disabled','deleted') to brands table
Add moderation_notes column (text, nullable) to brands table
Add moderation_status and moderation_notes columns to personas table (same definition)
Add moderation_status and moderation_notes columns to creatives table (same definition)
Create index on brands(moderation_status) for filtered queries
Create index on personas(moderation_status) for filtered queries
Create index on creatives(moderation_status) for filtered queries
Existing RLS policies continue to work (new columns are just additional data)
Migration runs successfully
